How Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution connects

  • Item: DSV Alvin — Alvin is operated by Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution.
  • Topic: Oceanography — Woods Hole is a leading Atlantic laboratory for deep-sea work.

What is Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution?

Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution (WHOI) is the private research lab beside the village of Woods Hole, operator of Alvin and a counterpart to Scripps on the Atlantic.

Key threads lead to DSV Alvin and Oceanography.
